table_path_note: table_path/extracted_path are local paths under data/raw/<id>-<slug>/extracted/; they are git-ignored. Run scripts/download_datasets.py to rebuild them from the committed zips.

datasets.name: AI4I 2020 Predictive Maintenance Dataset
datasets.attribution: UCI Machine Learning Repository (2020). AI4I 2020 Predictive Maintenance Dataset. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C5HS5C
datasets.scenario: CNC 铣床遥测（空气/过程温度、转速、扭矩、刀具磨损）预测设备故障，用于预测性维护。
datasets.notes: 目标列 Machine failure；同表另有 TWF/HDF/PWF/OSF/RNF 故障模式指示列。

datasets.name: Steel Plates Faults
datasets.attribution: M Buscema; S Terzi; W Tastle (2010). Steel Plates Faults. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C5J88N
datasets.scenario: 钢板表面缺陷检测：由 7 个缺陷指示列合成缺陷类别（多标签）。
datasets.notes: 末 7 列 Pastry/Z_Scratch/K_Scatch/Stains/Dirtiness/Bumps/Other_Faults 为 one-hot 指示，需合成类别。 非表成员：Faults27x7_var(documentation)

datasets.name: SECOM
datasets.attribution: Michael McCann; Adrian Johnston (2008). SECOM. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C54305
datasets.scenario: 半导体制造过程 590 路传感器信号异常检测（良品/不良品）。
datasets.notes: secom.data 为空白分隔的 590 特征矩阵（缺失记为 NaN）；secom_labels.data 为时间戳 + 标签。 非表成员：secom.names(documentation)

datasets.name: Steel Industry Energy Consumption
datasets.attribution: Sathishkumar V E; Changsun Shin; Yongyun Cho (2021). Steel Industry Energy Consumption. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C52G8C
datasets.scenario: 钢铁厂（Daewoo Steel）电力消耗建模与负荷预测。
datasets.notes: 含 CO2、功率因数、无功功率等派生列；时间戳 15 分钟粒度。

datasets.name: Productivity Prediction of Garment Employees
datasets.attribution: UCI Machine Learning Repository (2020). Productivity Prediction of Garment Employees. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C51S6D
datasets.scenario: 服装缝纫产线工人实际产出率回归。
datasets.notes: 同时含 targeted_productivity（计划值）；team 为 1-12 编号（类别型）。

datasets.name: Wholesale customers
datasets.attribution: Margarida Cardoso (2013). Wholesale customers. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C5030X
datasets.scenario: 批发分销商客户分群（6 个品类年采购额 + Channel/Region）。
datasets.notes: 聚类基准集；6 个金额列为 Fresh/Milk/Grocery/Frozen/Detergents_Paper/Delicassen。

datasets.name: Seoul Bike Sharing Demand
datasets.attribution: Sathishkumar Veerappampalayam  Easwaramoorthy (2020). Seoul Bike Sharing Demand. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C5F62R
datasets.scenario: 首尔公共自行车按小时租借需求预测。
datasets.notes: 逐小时 8760 行；含季节/节假日/天气协变量。

datasets.name: Power Consumption of Tetouan City
datasets.attribution: Abdulwahed Salam; Abdelaaziz El Hibaoui (2018). Power Consumption of Tetouan City. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C5B034
datasets.scenario: 摩洛哥 Tetouan 市三个供电分区 10 分钟粒度负荷预测。
datasets.notes: 另含 Zone 2/Zone 3 Power Consumption 及天气列。 API num_instances=52417 比数据行数多 1（API 把表头行计入）

datasets.name: Wine Quality
datasets.attribution: Paulo Cortez; A. Cerdeira; F. Almeida; T. Matos; J. Reis (2009). Wine Quality. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C56S3T
datasets.scenario: 红/白葡萄酒理化指标预测感官质量评分。
datasets.notes: 两个独立表：winequality-red.csv 与 winequality-white.csv（分隔符 ';'），合计 6497 行。 非表成员：winequality.names(documentation)

datasets.name: Electrical Grid Stability Simulated Data
datasets.attribution: Vadim Arzamasov (2018). Electrical Grid Stability Simulated Data . UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C5PG66
datasets.scenario: 电网暂态稳定仿真数据的二分类判定（stable / unstable）。
datasets.notes: stabf 为类别标签，stability 为连续裕度目标；12 个连续特征 + 2 个目标。

datasets.name: Airfoil Self-Noise
datasets.attribution: Thomas Brooks; D. Pope; Michael Marcolini (1989). Airfoil Self-Noise. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C5VW2C
datasets.scenario: 翼型自噪声声压级回归（NASA 风洞实验）。
datasets.notes: 无表头文件；5 个几何/气流特征 + 末列声压级。

datasets.name: Dataset for Sensorless Drive Diagnosis
datasets.attribution: Martyna Bator (2013). Dataset for Sensorless Drive Diagnosis. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C5VP5F
datasets.scenario: 无传感器电机驱动故障诊断：由电流/电压特征判别 11 种转子工况。
datasets.notes: 49 列、约 5.8 万行；末列为 11 类标签（电机负载/故障组合）。

datasets.name: Combined Cycle Power Plant
datasets.attribution: Pnar Tfekci; Heysem Kaya (2014). Combined Cycle Power Plant. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C5002N
datasets.scenario: 联合循环电厂满负荷输出功率（PE）回归。
datasets.notes: 目标 PE = electrical energy output；5 个 sheet 为同一批 9,568 条记录的不同排序（PE 值集已独立核对）；建模时取其一以免重复计数。 非表成员：Folds5x2_pp.ods(alternate), Readme.txt(documentation), Readme.txt~(documentation) 5 个 sheet 行列数完全相同（各 9,568×5）

datasets.name: Concrete Compressive Strength
datasets.attribution: I-Cheng Yeh (1998). Concrete Compressive Strength. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C5PK67
datasets.scenario: 混凝土配合比（水泥/矿渣/粉煤灰/水/外加剂/骨料/龄期）预测抗压强度。
datasets.notes: 旧版 XLS 格式；预期 1030 行 x 9 列。 非表成员：Concrete_Readme.txt(documentation)

datasets.name: Dry Bean
datasets.attribution: UCI Machine Learning Repository (2020). Dry Bean. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C50S4B
datasets.scenario: 干豆形态学特征（面积/周长/长宽比等）7 类品种识别。
datasets.notes: XLSX 含 Dry_Beans_Dataset（13,611×17，带表头）与 Citation_Request（仅 1 行引用文本，无数据行）；Class 为 7 类品种。 非表成员：Dry_Bean_Dataset.arff(alternate), Dry_Bean_Dataset.txt(documentation)
